reviews.goal_constraint_implicated: A final recommendation must cite one full-population scorecard from each of the 8 sites for the same model. The plan artifact s000034 selects m5 with coverage of only 1 of 8 required sites, which would violate this constraint if treated as a final recommendation. However, the note text frames this as a work order to complete coverage, not a completed recommendation. The constraint 'Stable-only evaluations are diagnostics, never full-population evidence. Do not invent results or misrepresent coverage' is not yet violated, but the plan risks premature commitment to m5 before the 7 missing site scorecards are obtained.
